subject: Longshot
text: Opening the chest in the Longshot Room yields the Longshot, which possesses double the range of the standard Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
Open the chest in front of you to get the Longshot.  This excellent little item
has double the range of the standard Hookshot.

subject: Block of Time
text: Playing the Song of Time moves the Block of Time embedded in the floor behind the chest out of the way, allowing Link to drop down the pit on the other side.

evidence.quote:
Go around behind the chest to find a Block of Time embedded in the floor.  Play the Song of Time to move it
out of the way, and drop down the pit on the other side.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: In The River Wild, a Gold Skulltula hangs on the ceiling directly above the third whirlpool and can be collected from the bottom of the river using the Iron Boots and Longshot.

evidence.quote:
As you pass around the second corner in the river, you'll see the Gold
Skulltula hanging on the ceiling, directly above the third whirlpool.

Use the Iron Boots to come to a stop, and grab the Gold Skulltula and it's
token from the bottom of the river.

subject: Small Key
text: Shooting the golden eye switch near the fifth whirlpool with an arrow opens the grating across from the platform, revealing a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Near the fifth whirlpool, right at the final corner of the river, there is a
small platform that you can climb up on.  Get on this platform and shoot the
golden eye switch with an arrow.  The grating across from the platform will
open.  Use the Longshot on the chest inside to pull yourself over before the
time limit runs out and the grating closes.  Open the chest for a Small Key.

subject: Whirlpool Room
text: Exiting through the door in the alcove of the Whirlpool Room leads back to the Vertical Hallway.

evidence.quote:
Climb out of the water to the alcove with the door.  Go out the door back to
the Vertical Hallway.

subject: Vertical Hallway
text: Floating to the top floor of the main chamber of the Vertical Hallway allows access to the Waterfall-Elevator Room through the west door.

evidence.quote:
Once you're back in the main chamber,
float all the way back to the top floor and go back through the west door to
the Waterfall-Elevator Room.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: In the Waterfall-Elevator Room, a Gold Skulltula sits on the wall to the right and can be defeated and retrieved using the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Look on the wall to the right to see that pesky Gold
Skulltula that was just out of your reach last time.  Use the incredible reach
of the Longshot to kill it and steal it's token, then return to the Vertical
Hallway.

subject: Water Level
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in front of the plaque in the room where Link met Ruto lowers the water level to its bottom level.

evidence.quote:
Equip the Iron Boots
and drop to the bottom level of the room, and go through the east hall back to
the room where you met Ruto.  Switch back to the Kokiri Boots and float all the
way up.  Play Zelda's Lullaby in front of the plaque to lower the water level
to it's bottom level.

subject: Water Level
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby in front of the plaque on the second level of the Central Tower sets the water level to its middle height.

evidence.quote:
Pull yourself up to the second level of the tower with the Longshot, and play
Zelda's Lullaby in front of the plaque to set the water level to it's middle
height.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Inside the Central Tower, a Gold Skulltula is located high up on the wall near the ceiling and can be killed and collected with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Climb onto the floating platform, and look high up on the wall, near
the ceiling of the tower, where you will spot a Gold Skulltula.  Use the
Longshot to kill it and take it's token, then go out the door to the second
level of the Vertical Hallway.

subject: Grating
text: Shooting the eye switch in the water with an arrow on the south side of the tower's exterior opens the grating covering the doorway.

evidence.quote:
Work your way around to the south side of the tower's exterior, where you will
find a doorway which is covered by a grating.  Shoot the eye in the water with
an arrow (that pesky Wizard arrives again to help Link defy the laws of
physics) to make the grating open.

subject: Small Key
text: Pushing the stone block forward in the passage on the south side of the tower opens a path to the right where a chest containing a Small Key is located.

evidence.quote:
Push the block forward until it stops, and then take a right down the passage
you just opened.  Open the chest to get a Small Key.

subject: The Water Pillar Room
text: Riding the water pillar to the third floor and passing through the top door leads back into the Vertical Hallway.

evidence.quote:
Ride the Water Pillar to the third floor, and go
through the door at the top.

subject: Water Level
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby at the plaque raises the water level back to its maximum height.

evidence.quote:
Play Zelda's Lullaby at the plaque to raise the water level back to it's
maximum height.

subject: Vertical Hallway
text: Sinking to the bottom level of the Vertical Hallway with the Iron Boots reveals a doorway at the north end containing a deep pit that leads to a short hallway and a room with spikes.

evidence.quote:
Equip your Iron Boots, and sink all the way back down to the bottom level
(yeah, that's right, back to the bottom floor).  Once on the bottom level, head
for the north end of the room to find a doorway which contains a deep pit.
Enter the pit and sink down with the continued help of the Iron Boots.  At the
end of the pit, go down a short hallway then change back to the Kokiri Boots to
float to the surface.

subject: The Not-As-Hard-As-It-Looks Room
text: Equipping the Iron Boots to walk along the pond floor while watching out for boulders leads to the northeast corner where Link can float up to grab the northern ledge and exit through the door.

evidence.quote:
The easy way: Equip the Iron Boots and walk along the bottom of the pond,
watching out for Boulders.  Run to the northeast corner of the pond, and switch
back to the Kokiri Boots.  As you float to the surface, grab onto the ledge on
the north corner of the room and pull yourself up.

subject: Water Level
text: Bombing the northwest and northeast walls in the Stone Block Room reveals a hidden tunnel with a stone block that, when pushed into the pool of water, activates the switch and raises the water level.

evidence.quote:
Bomb the walls in the northwest
and northeast corners of the room to reveal a hidden tunnel which contains a
stone block....Push it forward until it falls in the pool of water,
pressing down on the switch and permanently activating it.  The water level
will now rise.

subject: Water Pillar Triplets Room
text: Stepping on the switch in the corner of the Water Pillar Triplets Room causes three water pillars to rise and unlocks the door across the room.

evidence.quote:
Step on the switch in the corner, and three water pillars down in the pit will
rise, and the door across the room will unlock.

subject: Water Pillar Triplets Room
text: To cross the pit in the Water Pillar Triplets Room fastest, jump to the second water pillar and then jump straight for the door without jumping onto the third pillar.

evidence.quote:
To make it across the fastest, only jump
out to the second water pillar, then jump straight for the door.  You don't
need to jump on the third one.

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: In the passage of water in The Not-As-Hard-As-It-Looks Room, a Gold Skulltula is located on the right wall above the water pit.

evidence.quote:
Run forward and into the passage of water (watch out for boulders that roll
along here).  Look to the right, and kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall.  Take
it's token, then use the Iron Boots to drop down the water pit beneath the
Skulltula.

subject: Boss Key
text: Opening the ornate chest in the Boss Key Room yields the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Open the ornate chest to get the Boss Key.
